data.subject: PKBK filing and weekly research
data.body:
Hi, I’m Andrew, founder of Local Ledger, an independent research publisher using public records only, never issuer-paid.

Siena Capital Partners’ most recent 13F, for the period ended June 30, 2026, shows positions in PLBC, TSBK, and PKBK.

On September 24, 2026, PKBK disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1315399/000143774926031135/pkbk20260923_8k.htm).

I can send the free weekly issue and set up a four-week fund pilot for your team. Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.

Andrew
